title: Get Ready: Bond Yields are Exploding
speaker: A1 Trading host with guest Marilly

macro_themes.view: 10y above 5.2% (and 5.5% psychologically) draws profit-taking into risk-free yield, pulling liquidity from equities and gold.
Market prices Fed funds near 5% vs Fed projections of 4-4.25% even as oil eases; a sustainable Iran/oil resolution could collapse that fear premium.
PMIs and new orders at multi-year highs; the Iran/oil black cloud is what hangs over markets.
Mag 7 can borrow near or below Treasury yields and have levers on free cash flow; their relative strength is positive for the broader market.

calls.condition: Requires a sustainable Iran/oil resolution while growth stays strong
calls.reason: Russell has traded inversely to the 2-year; extreme bearish sentiment (AAII 48% bears) means a tangible Iran deal would drop the 2-year and give small caps a bigger upside move than the Nasdaq.
calls.quote: the upside to the Russell is um more like that's more of an outsized move in my opinion than something like the Nasdaq

calls.reason: Guest sees no sustainable decline in long-end yields unless the AI capex buildout slows or reverses, which she does not expect anytime soon.
calls.quote: what would make me think that yields would be sustainably coming down from there would be a reversal or a pause... which I just don't …
